name: 1D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A signal representation technique where a signal is decomposed into a sum of Gaussian probability density functions (kernels), analogous to Fourier decomposition using sines and cosines.
summary: 1D Gaussian Splatting is a signal representation technique that approximates a one-dimensional signal using a weighted sum of Gaussian kernels, offering a local alternative to global Fourier decomposition.
